request.style: English, solemn male baritone solo with low string choir, cello, viola, timpani, organ, dark and urgent, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Elisha called a son of prophets
Take the flask and go to Ramoth-gilead
Find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat
Pour the oil on his head

[Verse]
This is what the Lord says
I anoint you king over Israel
Strike down the house of Ahab
Avenge the blood of prophets

[Verse]
Jehu rode to Jezreel city
Joram asked if it came in peace
He drew his bow and shot the king
Between the shoulders and the heart

[Verse]
Throw him on the plot of Naboth
Repent for the blood of the prophet
Ahaziah fled to Megiddo
Where he died in his chariot

[Verse]
Jezebel looked out the window
Asking if Zimri came in peace
He called for help and they threw her down
Trampled by the horses

[Verse]
They found only skull and feet
No one could bury her body
Dogs devoured her in Jezreel
As Elijah had foretold

[Outro]
This is the word of the Lord
